name: alias
body: const g = new Guard(); const h = g; h.authorize();

name: reassignment
body: let g = new Guard(); g = makeGuard(); g.authorize();

name: reassignment-after-use
body: let g = new Guard(); g.authorize(); g = makeGuard();

name: method-reference
body: const g = new Guard(); const f = g.authorize;

name: nested-lambda
body: const g = new Guard(); expect(() => g.authorize());

name: branch
body: if (ok) { const g = new Guard(); g.authorize(); }
